ns2:course.label: Analog Circuits & Systems
ns2:course.description: Introduction to concepts from circuit and system analysis: linear systems, review of elementary circuit analysis, op amps, transient analysis, differential equation models of linear circuits and systems, and Laplace transform. Credit is not given for both ECE 211 and ECE 210. Prerequisite: ECE 110 and PHYS 212; credit or concurrent registration in MATH 285 or MATH 286.
